text:
alyssa: quick shout 10am chaos 10 mins of total slowness, turned out to be my halloween pumpkin (battery candle) sitting on the router. who knew flicker = packet storm? pic: (image: pumpkin-router.jpg) https://photos.example.com/pumpkin
trent: omg that is peak "fall decor takes down infra" :jack_o_lantern: :joy:
mina: wait is it the batteries or the flicker circuit? i've seen small motors cause noise before.
chuck: pro move: move decor 6 inches away. also, post a troubleshooting gif for morale.
alyssa: unplugged the pumpkin, ping to staging went from 320ms -> 25ms. infra-bot, confirm?
infra-bot: run by alyssa at 2170004335  pre-unplug avg ping=320ms loss=11% ; post-unplug avg ping=25ms loss=0% . full log in #eng-infra.
harper: too good. suggestion: "Seasonal decor vs wifi" show-and-tell tomorrow? winners get the coveted ops-sticker.
trent: yes! i'll bring my holiday string lights that turned into an AP in 2019.
mina: poll: morning or after-standup? react :one: for after-standup, :two: for evening.
alyssa: :one: (need time to hide the evidence)
trent: :one:
chuck: :two: (evening for me)
infra-bot: poll tally at 2170004355  :one: 2 votes, :two: 1 vote. after-standup wins.
alyssa: ok show-and-tell after standup. who will actually tidy before posting? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
participants poll replies: alyssa: maybe, trent: nope, mina: yes, chuck: maybe
